response.overview: LOST ON THE ROAD is a comedy feature film with a journey of Lord of the Rings proportions, but set in the British countryside. It follows four estranged friends that used to play Dungeons and Dragons together who reunite for a stag weekend. Jack, the sensible groom, hopes for a simple country walk but his chaotic friends have other ideas. With his wedding fast approaching, Jack faces a quest as epic as any they once rolled dice for: deciding whether to hold onto the ring... or let it go.
response.title: Lost On The Road
